rasar.roast_ammo: Rasar paid $73 for Le'Veon Bell in 2018 and got 0.0 fantasy points when Bell held out. He finished last. He also somehow drafted Justin Jefferson for $1 and Ja'Marr Chase for $2 in back-to-back years. The man is capable of brilliance and total catastrophe with equal confidence.

bruce.roast_ammo: Bruce paid $82 for Christian McCaffrey in 2024, a league-record single-player price, and finished last. He also went 1-12 in 2013, still one of the worst records in league history. Bruce commits fully to his studs strategy every year, and the results are historically inconsistent.

garrett.roast_ammo: Garrett paid $77 for Saquon Barkley in 2020, made 92 roster moves, and finished with a -33.0 point differential. That is the most active and least effective season in 17 years of this league. Ninety-two moves. Negative 33 points. Do not let him manage your 401k.

signature_moments.outcome: Championship, +24.4 DIFF, only 8 moves all season
signature_moments.note: Won his first championship in approximately a decade of trying. Made 8 total moves. The patience finally paid off.

patterns: Decade of 10th-12th place finishes before 2024
2024 championship with minimal roster moves (8 total)
Quiet low-activity manager who finally found the formula
kevin.roast_ammo: Kevin finished 10th-12th place for most of a decade before winning the 2024 championship with only 8 roster moves and a +24.4 point differential. Either he figured it out or everyone else got worse. The jury is still out on which.

cross.roast_ammo: Cross got Brock Bowers for $3 in 2024, the same draft where Travis Kelce went for $43. That is a $40 spread on similar-tier tight ends. Cross either knows something the room does not, or he got lucky enough that it does not matter.

moonshine.roast_ammo: Moonshine paid $40 for Sam LaPorta in 2024, a year where Travis Kelce went for $43. LaPorta is not worth $3 less than Travis Kelce. Moonshine overpaid at TE by approximately $25 and did it with confidence.

Reggie tends to freeze in the first hour of the auction and then wake up mid-draft.
